q.en: What does (double) (9 / 4) evaluate to, and how would you obtain 2.25?
q.zh: (double) (9 / 4) 得到什么？怎样得到 2.25？

a.en: It evaluates to 2.0. Integer division happens first; use 9 / 4.0 or ((double) 9) / 4 to introduce floating-point arithmetic before division.
a.zh: 得到 2.0。整数除法先发生。使用 9 / 4.0 或 ((double) 9) / 4，在除法前引入浮点运算。

q.en: Why does assigning integer division to double not restore a fraction?
q.zh: 为什么把整数除法结果赋给 double 不能恢复小数？

a.en: The division is already complete. Java converts the truncated integer result afterward. Convert an operand before dividing.
a.zh: 除法已经完成，Java 之后才转换截断后的整数结果。应在相除前转换一个操作数。

q.en: Why use long for 50000 times 50000?
q.zh: 为什么 50000 乘 50000 要使用 long？

a.en: The result 2500000000 exceeds Integer.MAX_VALUE. Make at least one operand long before multiplication so the operation uses the wider type.
a.zh: 结果 2500000000 超过 Integer.MAX_VALUE。乘法前先让至少一个操作数为 long，运算才使用更宽类型。

q.en: Does a valid parse make every integer acceptable?
q.zh: 能解析成功是否代表所有整数都可接受？

a.en: No. Parsing checks representation. A count may still require a nonnegative value or an upper limit.
a.zh: 不代表。解析检查表示方式；计数仍可能要求非负或不超过上限。

q.en: Why can a loop preserve its invariant yet fail to finish?
q.zh: 为什么循环能保持不变式，却仍不结束？

a.en: An invariant describes safety, not progress. If i never increases, the invariant can remain true forever; a decreasing bounded progress measure is needed to argue termination.
a.zh: 不变式描述安全性，不描述进展。若 i 从不增加，不变式可能永远成立。证明终止还需要一个不断减小且有下界的进度量。

q.en: Why is zero the correct starting total?
q.zh: 为什么总和从零开始？

a.en: No values have been processed. The sum of that empty prefix is zero, which establishes the invariant.
a.zh: 尚未处理任何值，空前缀之和为零，这建立了不变式。

q.en: Why put text != null before text.length()?
q.zh: 为什么 text != null 要放在 text.length() 前？

a.en: If text is null, && stops before calling length. Reversing the operands attempts the unsafe call first.
a.zh: text 为 null 时，&& 在调用 length 前停止。倒过来会先执行不安全调用。

q.en: If a method increments an Integer parameter with x++, does the caller see a changed Integer variable?
q.zh: 方法对 Integer 形参执行 x++，调用者的 Integer 变量会改变吗？

a.en: No. Integer is immutable; unboxing, incrementing and boxing lead to reassignment of the local parameter. The caller retains its original reference.
a.zh: 不会。Integer 不可变。拆箱、加一、装箱会让局部形参重新赋值，调用者仍保留原引用。

q.en: Which assignment crosses the method boundary?
q.zh: 哪种赋值效果可跨越方法边界？

a.en: Writing x[0] changes the shared array. Assigning a new array to x changes only the parameter variable.
a.zh: 写 x[0] 改变共享数组；给 x 赋新数组只改变形参变量。

q.en: How can the caller adopt the new array?
q.zh: 调用者怎样采用新数组？

a.en: Return its reference and assign the result to the caller’s variable. The caller then explicitly changes its own reference.
a.zh: 返回新引用，再由调用者赋给自己的变量。这样调用者明确改变自己的引用。

q.en: Why does incrementing Integer not change the caller variable?
q.zh: 为什么递增 Integer 不改变调用者变量？

a.en: Integer is immutable. Unboxing, addition, and boxing create a replacement value for the local parameter.
a.zh: Integer 不可变。拆箱、相加与装箱只是为局部形参产生替代值。

q.en: Why can Object[] values = new String[2] compile while values[0] = 5 fails at runtime?
q.zh: 为什么 Object[] values = new String[2] 能编译，而 values[0] = 5 在运行时失败？

a.en: Arrays are covariant, so the assignment is allowed. The actual array still accepts only String references; storing the boxed Integer triggers ArrayStoreException.
a.zh: 数组协变允许前一种赋值。实际数组仍只接受 String 引用，存入装箱后的 Integer 会触发 ArrayStoreException。

q.en: How many cells does {{2,5},{9}} contain?

a.en: Three: two in the first row and one in the second. Multiply rows by columns only after proving the array is rectangular.
a.zh: 三个：第一行两个，第二行一个。只有已确定为矩形时才能行数乘列数。

q.en: Does outer.clone isolate a row’s elements?
q.zh: outer.clone 会隔离行内元素吗？

a.en: No. It copies row references. Clone each primitive row if independent cell mutation is required.
a.zh: 不会。它复制的是行引用。需要独立修改单元时，应逐行克隆基本类型数组。

q.en: Why does an Object[] alias not permit arbitrary values in String[]?
q.zh: 为什么 Object[] 别名不能向 String[] 写任意值？

a.en: The actual array retains its String component type. A runtime store check rejects incompatible objects.
a.zh: 实际数组仍保留 String 元素类型，运行时存储检查会拒绝不兼容对象。

q.en: Why can s.replace("a", "b") appear to have no effect?
q.zh: 为什么 s.replace("a", "b") 看起来没有效果？

a.en: It returns a new String result. If the result is ignored, the variable s still refers to its previous value; assign the result or use it directly.
a.zh: 它返回新的 String 结果。忽略结果时，s 仍引用旧值。应赋值保存结果，或直接使用返回值。

q.en: Why is equals true but == false for two new strings?
q.zh: 两个新字符串为何 equals 真而 == 假？

a.en: Their characters match but they are distinct objects. Value equality and reference identity answer different questions.
a.zh: 字符内容相同，但对象不同。值相等与引用身份回答不同问题。

q.en: What does ignoring toUpperCase lose?
q.zh: 忽略 toUpperCase 的返回值会怎样？

a.en: The computed new value is unused. The original String and the variable’s reference stay unchanged.
a.zh: 算出的新值未被使用，原 String 和变量引用都保持不变。

q.en: Can one visible symbol occupy two char values?
q.zh: 一个可见符号能占两个 char 吗？

a.en: Yes. A supplementary Unicode code point uses a UTF-16 surrogate pair. User-perceived characters can be more complex still.
a.zh: 可以。补充平面 Unicode 码点使用 UTF-16 代理对。用户感知字符还可能更复杂。

q.en: Can a final List field still have elements added?
q.zh: final List 字段还能添加元素吗？

a.en: Yes. final prevents replacing the field reference. It does not make the referenced List immutable or prevent its mutation methods.
a.zh: 能。final 阻止替换字段引用，不会让所指 List 不可变，也不会禁用修改方法。

q.en: Why validate before changing level?
q.zh: 为什么改变 level 前先检查？

a.en: If validation fails, the old valid state remains intact. Changing first may expose or require undoing an invalid state.
a.zh: 验证失败时旧有效状态保持完整。先改变再检查可能暴露无效状态，或需要回滚。

q.en: Why compare q with capacity−level?
q.zh: 为什么比较 q 与 capacity−level？

a.en: The remaining capacity is safe to compute under 0≤level≤capacity. Forming level+q first could overflow for large integers.
a.zh: 在 0≤level≤capacity 下，剩余容量可安全计算。先算 level+q 可能在大整数时溢出。

q.en: Does final int[] mean immutable elements?
q.zh: final int[] 代表元素不可变吗？

a.en: No. It fixes the stored reference. The array elements remain writable unless access is controlled.
a.zh: 不代表。它固定存储的引用；除非限制访问，数组元素仍可写。

q.en: Why is a private final array still not enough?
q.zh: 为什么 private final 数组仍然不够？

a.en: private hides the field name, and final prevents reassignment. A reference returned by a getter can still modify the array. Return a copy or design a read-only operation instead.
a.zh: private 隐藏字段名，final 禁止重新赋值。getter 返回的引用仍能修改数组。应返回副本，或设计只读操作。

q.en: After nextInt reads 12, why might nextLine return an empty string?
q.zh: nextInt 读到 12 后，为什么 nextLine 可能返回空字符串？

a.en: The numeric token was consumed but the line terminator remained. nextLine consumes the rest of that line. Use a consistent line-based parser or intentionally consume the remainder.
a.zh: 数字词元已被消费，但行结束符仍在。nextLine 读取该行剩余部分。可以统一按行解析，或有意消费剩余部分。

q.en: Why does nextLine return an empty remainder?
q.zh: nextLine 为什么返回空的剩余内容？

a.en: nextInt consumed the digits but not the line ending. The next line call consumes the empty remainder before that boundary.
a.zh: nextInt 消耗数字，却未消耗行终止。下一次行读取取得终止符前空的剩余内容。

q.en: Why distinguish parse errors from negative counts?
q.zh: 为什么区分解析错误与负计数？

a.en: The first means text is not a valid integer. The second is a valid integer that violates the data contract. They require different explanations.
a.zh: 前者表示文本不是合法整数；后者是合法整数，却违反数据契约。两种情况需要不同解释。

q.en: If a record contains two ints and one double, how many bytes does that fixed primitive layout use before any header?
q.zh: 一个记录包含两个 int 和一个 double，在文件头之前共需多少字节？

a.en: 16 bytes: each DataOutput int uses 4 bytes and a double uses 8, so 4 + 4 + 8 = 16. A version field or string would add its own representation cost.
a.zh: 16 字节。DataOutput 的每个 int 占 4 字节，double 占 8，所以 4 + 4 + 8 = 16。版本字段或字符串还会增加自身表示所需空间。

q.en: Why is the sensor record twelve bytes?
q.zh: 传感器记录为何是十二字节？

a.en: DataOutput writes the int in four bytes and the double in eight. The stated record has no extra header or string.
a.zh: DataOutput 用四字节写 int、八字节写 double。所述记录没有额外头部或字符串。

q.en: Does native machine endianness change writeInt?
q.zh: 机器本地字节序会改变 writeInt 吗？

a.en: No. The DataOutput contract specifies most-significant-byte-first order. The API defines the file representation.
a.zh: 不会。DataOutput 契约规定高位字节在前，由接口定义文件表示。

q.en: Should missing bytes be interpreted as zeros?
q.zh: 缺失字节能当作零吗？

a.en: No. That fabricates a different record. A readInt or readDouble that lacks bytes throws EOFException.
a.zh: 不能。那会编造另一条记录。readInt 或 readDouble 字节不足时抛 EOFException。

q.en: Which collection represents usernames with their latest login times, and what happens when a username is inserted twice?
q.zh: 哪种集合适合保存用户名及最近登录时间？同名插入两次会怎样？

a.en: A Map from username to timestamp fits. A put for an equal existing key replaces its associated value, so the number of keys does not increase.
a.zh: 使用从用户名映射到时间戳的 Map。put 遇到相等的已有键会替换对应值，键数量不会增加。

q.en: Why do three arrivals produce two set members?
q.zh: 三次到达为何只有两个集合成员？

a.en: The repeated name remains a separate list event but equals an existing set value. Containers answer different questions.
a.zh: 重复名称在列表中仍是独立事件，在集合中却等于已有值。容器回答不同问题。

q.en: Does replacing a map value add a key?
q.zh: 替换映射值会增加键吗？

a.en: Not for an equal existing key. It updates the association and keeps the key count unchanged.
a.zh: 相等键已存在时不会。它只更新关联，键数不变。

q.en: Why use Deque for a queue?
q.zh: 队列为何适合使用 Deque？

a.en: The operations name the endpoints directly. They avoid treating repeated removal at the front as arbitrary indexed list work.
a.zh: 操作直接表达端点，避免把反复从头删除当作一般索引列表操作。

q.en: Can two unequal objects legally return hash code 42?
q.zh: 两个不相等对象合法地返回哈希值 42，可以吗？

a.en: Yes. Collisions are legal; the collection must use equality to distinguish them. Returning 42 for every object can satisfy the contract while causing poor performance.
a.zh: 可以。碰撞合法，集合必须继续用相等性区分。全部对象返回 42 也能满足契约，但性能可能很差。

q.en: Why override both equals and hashCode?
q.zh: 为何同时重写 equals 与 hashCode？

a.en: A hash collection uses the hash to find candidates and equality to distinguish them. Equal objects must be routed consistently.
a.zh: 哈希容器先用哈希寻找候选，再用相等关系区分。相等对象必须得到一致路由。

q.en: Does one shared hash make two values equal?
q.zh: 哈希相同就表示值相等吗？

a.en: No. The implication runs from equality to equal hash, not backward. The second example keeps two colliding keys.
a.zh: 不表示。只有相等推出同哈希，反向不成立。第二示例保留两个冲突键。

q.en: Why keep key fields final?
q.zh: 为什么把键字段设为 final？

a.en: Stable equality fields make the lookup contract easier to preserve while a key is stored. final does not recursively freeze referenced mutable objects.
a.zh: 稳定的相等字段有助于在键存储期间保持查找契约。final 不会递归冻结引用的可变对象。

q.en: Does a collision mean one note must be lost?
q.zh: 发生哈希冲突，就一定会丢失一条说明吗？

a.en: No. Distinct keys can share a hash. HashMap also checks equality, so this example retains two entries.
a.zh: 不会。不同键可以共享哈希；HashMap 还会检查相等关系，所以本例保留两条记录。

q.en: Why is a read-only collection a problematic subtype of a contract that promises successful add operations?
q.zh: 只读集合为什么很难作为“保证 add 成功”的契约的子类型？

a.en: It cannot preserve the promised operation. The abstraction should distinguish readable capabilities from mutable capabilities, or explicitly document that mutation may be unsupported.
a.zh: 它无法保留承诺操作。抽象应区分读取能力与修改能力，或明确约定修改可能不受支持。

q.en: Why must the child constructor call super?
q.zh: 子类构造器为什么调用 super？

a.en: The superclass portion must establish valid state before the child is usable. Constructors are not inherited like methods.
a.zh: 子类可用前，父类部分必须建立有效状态。构造器不像普通方法那样被继承。

q.en: Can a subtype reject inputs its parent promised to accept?
q.zh: 子类型能拒绝父类型承诺接受的输入吗？

a.en: That strengthens the precondition and breaks substitutability unless the shared contract already permits rejection.
a.zh: 那会加强前置条件，破坏可替换性，除非共同契约本来就允许拒绝。

q.en: Can String describe() override Object describe() in a subclass?
q.zh: 子类的 String describe() 可以重写 Object describe() 吗？

a.en: Yes, when both are otherwise compatible instance methods: String is a covariant return type. Merely adding Object describe() and String describe() to the same class would not form valid overloads.
a.zh: 可以，前提是其他条件兼容且都是实例方法。String 属于协变返回类型。但在同一类中只增加这两个方法，不构成合法重载。

q.en: Why does an Object variable select show(Object)?
q.zh: 为什么 Object 变量选择 show(Object)？

a.en: Overload resolution uses the expression’s compile-time type. The contained String does not restart that search at runtime.
a.zh: 重载解析使用表达式编译期类型。内部装的是 String，也不会在运行时重新搜索重载。

q.en: What then chooses FancyPrinter’s implementation?
q.zh: 之后什么选择 FancyPrinter 的实现？

a.en: The runtime receiver class supplies the override of the already selected show(Object) signature.
a.zh: 运行时接收者类，为已经选定的 show(Object) 签名提供重写实现。

q.en: Can changing only return type create an overload?
q.zh: 只改返回类型能建立重载吗？

a.en: No. The parameter list must distinguish ordinary overloads. A subtype can use a compatible covariant return in an override.
a.zh: 不能。普通重载必须由参数列表区分。子类型重写则可采用兼容的协变返回类型。

q.en: Can an abstract class have a constructor even though it cannot be instantiated directly?
q.zh: 抽象类不能直接实例化，为什么还能有构造器？

a.en: Yes. Its constructor initializes the superclass portion of a concrete subclass instance. Abstract prevents direct construction, not constructor execution during subclass initialization.
a.zh: 构造器用于初始化具体子类实例中的父类部分。abstract 阻止直接构造，不阻止子类初始化时执行父类构造器。

q.en: Can an abstract constructor run?
q.zh: 抽象类构造器能运行吗？

a.en: Yes. It initializes the superclass part of a concrete subclass object. Only direct construction of the abstract class is forbidden.
a.zh: 可以。它初始化具体子类对象的父类部分。禁止的是直接构造抽象类。

q.en: Why must conflicting defaults be resolved?
q.zh: 为什么必须解决冲突默认方法？

a.en: Neither unrelated interface implementation is more specific. The class must choose or define a combined behavior explicitly.
a.zh: 两个无关接口实现没有谁更具体。类必须明确选择或定义组合行为。

q.en: Are interface fields per-instance mutable data?
q.zh: 接口字段是每个实例的可变数据吗？

a.en: No. They are implicitly public static final. Use an implementing class or abstract superclass for instance state.
a.zh: 不是。它们隐含为 public static final。实例状态应放在实现类或抽象父类中。

q.en: Does T extends Number let a method add two T values with the + operator?
q.zh: T extends Number 允许用 + 相加两个 T 吗？

a.en: No. The bound permits Number methods such as doubleValue, but it does not define numeric operators for an arbitrary T. Choose an explicit result representation or pass an operation.
a.zh: 不允许。上界允许 doubleValue 等 Number 方法，却没有为任意 T 定义数值运算符。应明确选择结果表示，或传入运算行为。

q.en: Why can Box<String>.get return String without a caller cast?
q.zh: Box<String>.get 为什么不需调用者强转就返回 String？

a.en: The type parameter connects stored and returned types at compile time. The compiler checks that relationship for each use.
a.zh: 类型参数在编译期连接存储与返回类型，编译器为每次使用检查该关系。

q.en: Why write a type parameter before a static method’s return type?
q.zh: 静态方法返回类型前为何声明类型参数？

a.en: The method declares its own parameter. It cannot use an instance-specific T as though it belonged to one shared static method.
a.zh: 方法要声明自己的类型参数，不能把某实例特有的 T 当作共享静态方法的类型。

q.en: Does type safety guarantee a list has a first element?
q.zh: 类型安全保证列表有首项吗？

a.en: No. Element type and collection size are different conditions. The method still checks for an empty list.
a.zh: 不保证。元素类型与集合大小是不同条件，方法仍需检查空列表。

q.en: Why can a List<Object> be passed to a method expecting List<? super Integer> but not List<Integer>?
q.zh: 为什么 List<Object> 可传给 List<? super Integer> 参数，却不能传给 List<Integer>？

a.en: Object is a supertype of Integer, so accepting Integer writes is safe. Invariance prevents treating a list that may contain arbitrary Objects as if every element were Integer.
a.zh: Object 是 Integer 父类型，所以保证接受 Integer 写入是安全的。不变性阻止把可能含任意 Object 的列表当成每项都是 Integer 的列表。

q.en: Why can an extends view not accept a Double?
q.zh: 为什么 extends 视图不能接收 Double？

a.en: Its hidden element type may be Integer. Adding a Double would violate the original list’s promise.
a.zh: 隐藏元素类型可能为 Integer，加入 Double 会破坏原列表承诺。

q.en: What type can be read safely from ? super Integer?
q.zh: 从 ? super Integer 能安全读成什么类型？

a.en: Object. The list may also contain earlier values of a wider element type. Integer writes are safe, but not every stored item is Integer.
a.zh: Object。列表可能含先前加入的更宽类型值。写 Integer 安全，但并非所有存储值都是 Integer。

q.en: Does ? extends Number forbid clear or remove?
q.zh: ? extends Number 禁止 clear 或 remove 吗？

a.en: No. The wildcard restricts element type operations, not every mutation. The concrete list decides which mutation methods are supported.
a.zh: 不禁止。通配符限制元素类型操作，不限制所有修改。具体列表决定支持哪些修改方法。

q.en: If two nodes point to one another but no live root reaches either, must the cycle remain forever?
q.zh: 两个节点互相引用，但没有活动根能到达它们，这个循环必须永远保留吗？

a.en: No. Reachability-based collection can reclaim the unreachable cycle. Internal references do not create a path from a live root.
a.zh: 不必。基于可达性的回收可以回收该循环。内部引用不会自动建立从活动根出发的路径。

q.en: Why do two iterators both first return oak?
q.zh: 两个迭代器为何第一次都返回 oak？

a.en: Each has its own cursor. Sharing the list does not mean sharing traversal position.
a.zh: 每个迭代器有自己的游标。共享列表不等于共享遍历位置。

q.en: Why use iterator.remove during traversal?
q.zh: 遍历中为什么使用 iterator.remove？

a.en: It is the iterator’s supported way to remove the last returned element. Arbitrary structural edits through the list may invalidate its traversal assumptions.
a.zh: 它是迭代器支持的删除最后返回元素方式。随意通过列表改结构可能使遍历假设失效。

q.en: Does setting one variable to null prove collection occurred?
q.zh: 把一个变量设为 null 能证明垃圾回收发生吗？

a.en: No. Other strong paths may remain. Even if none remain, eligibility does not promise immediate collection.
a.zh: 不能。其他强引用路径可能仍在。即使没有路径，也只表示有资格回收，不承诺立即回收。

q.en: If a method declares throws IOException, has it recovered from file failures?
q.zh: 方法声明 throws IOException，是否已从文件失败中恢复？

a.en: No. It has declared that those failures may propagate. A caller or higher boundary must decide whether to recover, report, translate or propagate them further.
a.zh: 没有。它只声明失败可能向上传播。调用者或更高边界仍需决定恢复、报告、转换或继续传播。

q.en: Does throws perform recovery?
q.zh: throws 会执行恢复吗？

a.en: No. It declares permitted propagation. A catch at an appropriate boundary chooses whether to recover, report, or rethrow.
a.zh: 不会。它声明允许传播。合适边界上的 catch 决定恢复、报告或再次抛出。

q.en: Why validate before adding?
q.zh: 为什么相加前先验证？

a.en: A rejected operation can then leave the old state unchanged. This is a concrete failure contract that a caller can rely on.
a.zh: 这样拒绝操作可保持旧状态不变，成为调用者可依赖的明确失败契约。

q.en: Why close resources on the exceptional path too?
q.zh: 异常路径为什么也要关闭资源？

a.en: Failure does not end ownership obligations. Try-with-resources arranges close when control leaves the block.
a.zh: 失败不会消除所有权责任。资源型 try 在离开块时安排 close。

q.en: Why is comparing an enum constant with == appropriate while comparing arbitrary String contents with == is usually wrong?
q.zh: 为什么 enum 用 == 比较合适，而任意 String 内容通常不能用 ==？

a.en: Each enum constant is a unique fixed instance, so identity represents that named value. Distinct String objects can contain equal text, so content comparison requires equals.
a.zh: 每个枚举常量都是唯一固定实例，因此身份代表该命名值。不同 String 对象可能包含相同文本，内容比较需要 equals。

q.en: Does an enum prevent every invalid transition?
q.zh: 枚举能阻止所有无效转换吗？

a.en: No. It restricts state names. A separate operation must reject unsupported state-event pairs.
a.zh: 不能。它只限制状态名称。必须由独立操作拒绝不支持的状态事件组合。

q.en: Why compare enum values with ==?
q.zh: 枚举值为何可用 == 比较？

a.en: Each declared constant is one fixed instance. Identity represents that named enum value.
a.zh: 每个声明常量都是固定实例，身份就代表这个枚举值。

q.en: Why avoid persisting ordinal?
q.zh: 为什么避免持久保存 ordinal？

a.en: Ordinal is the declaration position. Inserting or reordering constants changes it. Explicit codes can preserve a format contract.
a.zh: ordinal 是声明位置。插入或重排常量会改变它，显式编码则可保持格式契约。

q.en: Why is assert amount > 0 insufficient to validate an externally supplied removal amount?
q.zh: 为什么 assert amount > 0 不足以验证外部提供的移除数量？

a.en: Java assertions may be disabled. The program must use an ordinary conditional and appropriate exception or error response to enforce a public input requirement reliably.
a.zh: Java 断言可能关闭。程序必须用普通条件语句与合适异常或错误响应，可靠约束公开输入。

q.en: Why create a fresh object for each reservation test?
q.zh: 为什么每个预留测试都新建对象？

a.en: Otherwise one test’s mutation changes the next test’s starting state. Independent fixtures make each expected result interpretable.
a.zh: 否则一个测试的修改会改变下一个初态。独立环境让每项预期结果可解释。

q.en: Why not rely on Java assert for public validation?
q.zh: 公共输入验证为何不能只靠 Java assert？

a.en: The assert statement can be disabled. A normal conditional and exception always enforce the input contract.
a.zh: assert 可以关闭。普通条件与异常才能始终落实输入契约。

q.en: Does branch coverage prove expected values are correct?
q.zh: 分支覆盖能证明预期值正确吗？

a.en: No. It records execution. A test must still compare meaningful observations with an independently derived expectation.
a.zh: 不能。它记录的是执行。测试仍需把有意义观察与独立推导的预期比较。

q.en: Why does memoization not automatically solve a StackOverflowError?
q.zh: 为什么记忆化不自动解决 StackOverflowError？

a.en: It reduces repeated computation but may leave the longest chain of recursive calls unchanged. An iterative dynamic program can avoid that deep call chain.
a.zh: 它减少重复计算，却可能不改变最长递归调用链。迭代动态规划可以避免深调用链。

q.en: Why is ways(0) one?
q.zh: ways(0) 为什么为一？

a.en: There is one empty sequence of moves covering zero steps. This base case makes the recurrence count combinations correctly.
a.zh: 覆盖零阶有一种空移动序列。这个基本情况让递推正确统计组合。

q.en: What does memoization remove?
q.zh: 记忆化消除了什么？

a.en: Repeated evaluation of the same state. It does not necessarily shorten the longest dependency chain or prevent deep-stack failure.
a.zh: 消除同一状态的重复计算，不一定缩短最长依赖链，也不一定避免深栈失败。

q.en: Why must a cache key include the allowed step rule?
q.zh: 缓存键为什么必须包含允许步长规则？

a.en: Changing allowed moves can change the answer for the same n. A cache indexed only by n is valid only while that rule stays fixed.
a.zh: 允许移动规则改变后，同一 n 的答案可能改变。只按 n 缓存仅在规则固定时有效。

q.en: Can an interface with one abstract method and two default methods be a lambda target?
q.zh: 含一个抽象方法和两个 default 方法的接口可以作 lambda 目标吗？

a.en: Yes, assuming it satisfies the full functional-interface rules. Default methods already have implementations and do not add required abstract operations.
a.zh: 可以，前提是满足完整函数式接口规则。default 方法已有实现，不增加必须实现的抽象操作。

q.en: When does a lambda body run?
q.zh: lambda 主体何时执行？

a.en: When the functional method is called, not simply when the lambda is created.
a.zh: 调用函数式方法时执行，不是仅在创建 lambda 时执行。

q.en: What does this mean inside a lambda?
q.zh: lambda 内的 this 表示什么？

a.en: It keeps the meaning from the enclosing instance context. An anonymous class introduces its own instance instead.
a.zh: 沿用外围实例上下文的含义；匿名类则引入自己的实例。

q.en: Why is a breakpoint just before the wrong output sometimes too late to understand the defect?
q.zh: 为什么仅在错误输出前设断点，有时太晚而无法理解缺陷？

a.en: The bad state may have been created much earlier. Trace backward to where an invariant first became false, then observe the operation that caused that first divergence.
a.zh: 错误状态可能早已产生。向前追踪不变式首次变假的位置，再观察造成第一次偏差的操作。

q.en: Why inspect operand types before changing a formula?
q.zh: 为什么改公式前要查看操作数类型？

a.en: The written formula may be correct while the language evaluates an intermediate operation in the wrong numeric domain.
a.zh: 纸面公式可能正确，但语言可能在不合适的数值类型中执行中间运算。

q.en: What should documentation promise?
q.zh: 文档应该承诺什么？

a.en: Observable behavior: accepted inputs, returned meaning, state effects and expected failures. Avoid promising accidental implementation details.
a.zh: 承诺可观察行为：接受的输入、返回含义、状态影响与预期失败。不要承诺偶然的实现细节。

q.en: Is a print statement a proof?
q.zh: 打印语句是证明吗？

a.en: It is evidence from one execution. Use it to test a hypothesis, then retain a focused regression check.
a.zh: 它是一次执行的证据。用它检验假设，再保留聚焦的回归检查。

q.en: What becomes easier when display code reads model state but does not own the domain rules?
q.zh: 显示代码只读取模型、不拥有领域规则，会让什么更容易？

a.en: The rules can be tested and reused independently of the interface. A command-line view or a different graphical view can call the same model operations without duplicating their logic.
a.zh: 规则可独立于界面测试和复用。命令行视图或另一图形视图能调用相同模型操作，无需复制逻辑。

q.en: Why keep rules outside a button callback?
q.zh: 为什么把规则放在按钮回调之外？

a.en: The same rules can be tested and reused without opening a window. The callback then translates an event into a request.
a.zh: 同一规则可在不开窗口时测试与复用。回调只负责把事件转换为请求。

q.en: Who decides whether watering is allowed?
q.zh: 谁决定是否允许浇水？

a.en: The model or an explicit policy should enforce that rule. A disabled button alone does not protect other callers.
a.zh: 应由模型或明确策略强制执行规则。只禁用按钮无法约束其他调用者。

q.en: Does separating layers require many classes?
q.zh: 分离层次一定需要很多类吗？

a.en: No. Begin with distinct responsibilities and clear method contracts. Add classes when ownership or interchangeable behavior makes that useful.
a.zh: 不一定。先区分职责与方法契约；当所有权或可替换行为需要时再增加类。

title.en: Observe when conversion happens
title.zh: 观察转换发生的时点

intro.en: Compare integer division, floating division, and widening before multiplication.
intro.zh: 比较整数除法、浮点除法与乘法前扩宽。

questions.output:
late=3.0
early=3.5
area=2500000000
truncate=-3

en: Declare trips and days as int, so the first division uses integer arithmetic.
Cast trips before division and width before multiplication to change the operation’s type.
Print named results so the point where information is lost is visible.
zh: trips 和 days 都声明为 int，因此第一次除法采用整数运算。
在除法前转换 trips，在乘法前转换 width，以改变运算类型。
打印带名称的结果，显示信息在哪里丢失。

title.en: Separate parsing from accepted range
title.zh: 分开解析与有效范围

intro.en: Process fixed text inputs without interactive prompts.
intro.zh: 处理固定文本，不需要交互输入。

questions.output:
12: accepted 12
-2: negative count
twelve: invalid int text
2147483648: invalid int text

en: The array supplies four contrasting inputs in a fixed order.
parseInt validates the decimal int representation before the sign rule runs.
The catch reports conversion failure and lets the next iteration proceed.
zh: 数组按固定顺序提供四种不同输入。
parseInt 先检查十进制 int 表示，再执行符号规则。
catch 报告转换失败，并让下一次迭代继续。

title.en: Trace the processed prefix
title.zh: 追踪已处理前缀

intro.en: Print the invariant’s state after each update.
intro.zh: 每次更新后打印不变式状态。

questions.output:
processed=1, total=4
processed=2, total=4
processed=3, total=11
empty total=0

en: Initialize total to establish the empty-prefix invariant.
Use i<length so every indexed read is within bounds.
Print after adding, then separately run the same accumulation idea on empty input.
zh: 初始化 total，建立空前缀不变式。
使用 i<length，让每次索引读取都在边界内。
相加后打印，再在空输入上运行同样的累加思路。

title.en: Guard null and stop at the first match
title.zh: 保护空引用并在首个匹配处停止

intro.en: Combine short-circuit guards with a bounded search.
intro.zh: 组合短路保护与有界搜索。

questions.output:
first length-four index=3
matched=pine

en: Use −1 as a documented no-match marker.
Skip invalid entries with continue before calling other String methods.
Store the first matching index and exit the loop with break.
zh: 使用 −1 作为明确的未找到标记。
先用 continue 跳过无效项，再调用其他 String 方法。
保存首个匹配索引，并用 break 退出循环。

title.en: Compare mutation with reassignment
title.zh: 比较修改与重新赋值

intro.en: Keep the caller’s original array visible after the call.
intro.zh: 调用后观察调用者原数组。

questions.output:
after mutation=[10, 8]
local replacement=[1, 2]
caller=[10, 8]

en: Pass the scores reference value into a fresh parameter x.
Modify the shared element before rebinding the parameter.
Inspect scores after return to observe which change survived.
zh: 把 scores 的引用值复制到新形参 x。
先修改共享元素，再重新绑定形参。
返回后检查 scores，判断哪种改动对调用者可见。

title.en: Return a replacement deliberately
title.zh: 明确返回替代引用

intro.en: Contrast copying a primitive wrapper with accepting a returned array.
intro.zh: 比较复制包装值与接收返回数组。

questions.output:
local count=5
caller count=4
original=[2, 5]
adopted=[4, 10]

en: Observe a local wrapper replacement separately from the caller’s count.
Clone before doubling so the input contract has no mutation.
Assign the returned reference explicitly at the caller.
zh: 分别观察局部包装值替换与调用者 count。
先克隆再加倍，使输入不被修改。
由调用者明确接收返回引用。

title.en: Trace shallow and row-wise copies
title.zh: 追踪浅复制与逐行复制

intro.en: Observe which edit crosses each copying boundary.
intro.zh: 观察哪些修改越过各复制边界。

questions.output:
original=[[2, 7], [9]]
shallow=[[2, 7], [4, 6, 8]]
original after isolated edit=[[2, 7], [9]]

en: Clone the outer array and mutate one shared row.
Replace one row reference to separate slot mutation from cell mutation.
Clone individual rows before making an isolated edit.
zh: 克隆外层数组并修改共享行。
替换一个行引用，区分槽位修改与单元修改。
独立修改之前先逐行克隆。

title.en: Handle null rows and checked stores
title.zh: 处理 null 行与受检查的存储

intro.en: Show two array boundaries without letting the program crash.
intro.zh: 展示两种数组边界，并明确处理失败。

questions.output:
cells=3
incompatible store rejected
second slot=null

en: Assign a String array to a wider reference type while retaining its actual component type.
Catch the deliberate store failure and inspect unchanged state.
zh: 读取 length 前先检查 row!=null。
将 String 数组赋给较宽引用类型，但实际元素类型保留。
捕获刻意触发的存储失败，并检查状态未变。

title.en: Separate text value from object identity
title.zh: 区分文本值与对象身份

intro.en: Use distinct objects so literal interning cannot hide a bad comparison.
intro.zh: 使用不同对象，避免字符串常量驻留掩盖错误比较。

questions.output:
identity=false
content=true
ignored result=harbor
assigned result=HARBOR

en: Create equal text in different objects and print both comparison rules.
Call a transformation without assigning its result.
Assign the returned String and inspect the changed variable.
zh: 在不同对象中创建相同文本，打印两种比较结果。
调用变换但不接收结果。
接收返回的 String，再观察变量改变。

title.en: Build labels and count Unicode units
title.zh: 构建标签并统计 Unicode 单位

intro.en: Contrast text assembly with the unit used for indexing.
intro.zh: 对照文本组合与索引使用的单位。

questions.output:
Day 1, Day 2, Day 3
code units=2
code points=1

en: Append separators conditionally while the loop generates labels.
Create a supplementary code point with Character.toChars.
Compare length with codePointCount using the same complete String range.
zh: 循环生成标签时有条件地追加分隔符。
用 Character.toChars 创建补充码点。
在相同完整字符串范围内比较 length 与 codePointCount。

title.en: Protect a capacity invariant
title.zh: 保护容量不变式

intro.en: Test success, rejection, and independent instance state.
intro.zh: 测试成功、拒绝与独立实例状态。

questions.output:
after fill=9
rejected
after rejection=9
other instance=0

en: Construct two valid instances with separate fields.
Accept five units, then reject four without mutation.
Read both instances to test rejection and isolation.
zh: 构建字段彼此独立的两个有效实例。
接受五单位，再拒绝四单位且不修改状态。
读取两个实例，检查拒绝与隔离。

title.en: Protect an internal array
title.zh: 保护内部数组

intro.en: Attack both input and output aliases with deliberate edits.
intro.zh: 通过刻意修改检查输入与输出别名。

questions.output:
supplied=[99, 5]
exported=[2, 77]
protected=[2, 5]

en: Copy the array at construction rather than retaining the caller’s alias.
Return a copy when exposing the values.
Print a fresh getter result after both outside edits.
zh: 构造时复制数组，不保留调用者别名。
两次外部编辑后，重新获取并打印内部值。

title.en: Protect a score snapshot from outside changes
title.zh: 保护成绩快照，隔离外部修改

intro.en: Mina records three quiz scores. She gives the array to a report object, then corrects her own working array. The printed report unexpectedly changes. Making the field private did not stop this: both variables still pointed to the same array. She changes the constructor to copy the input. Then she notices that a getter can leak the same array again. A second copy at the output boundary makes the report a stable snapshot.
intro.zh: 米娜保存了三次测验成绩。她把数组传入报告对象，随后修改自己的工作数组，却发现报告也变了。private 没能阻止这个问题：两处引用指向同一个数组。于是她让构造器复制输入。接着她又发现，getter 也可能把内部数组交出去。在输出边界再复制一次，报告才成为稳定的快照。

questions.output:
snapshot: [70, 80, 90]
total: 240
invalid score rejected

en: Copy before storing. Validation examines the actual copy that the object will own.
The getter returns another array. Changing that return value cannot change the owned array.
Mutate both outside arrays, then check the report. This tests the boundary, not just the initial total.
Reject 101. Accept an empty array with total zero. addExact turns an integer overflow into an explicit error.
zh: 先复制，再保存。校验针对对象实际拥有的那份副本。
getter 再返回一份数组，修改返回值不会影响内部存储。
分别修改两份外部数组，再核对报告，测试的是边界保护而非初始求和。
拒绝 101；空数组的总分为零。addExact 会把整数溢出变成明确异常。

title.en: Observe a token followed by a line
title.zh: 观察数字项之后的行

intro.en: All input is supplied in memory.
intro.zh: 全部输入来自内存。

questions.output:
count=12
remainder length=0
name=lamp

en: Supply a number line followed by a name line.
Read the token and explicitly inspect the leftover line.
Read the next full line and close the owned scanner.
zh: 提供一行数字与下一行名称。
读取数字项，并明确检查行的剩余部分。
读取下一整行，再关闭自己的 scanner。

title.en: Validate complete equipment records
title.zh: 验证完整设备记录

intro.en: Reject malformed and negative quantities without losing the good records.
intro.zh: 拒绝格式错误与负数量，同时保留有效记录。

questions.output:
line 3: bad integer
line 4: negative count
accepted total=8

en: Read whole lines and maintain a one-based line number.
Check record structure before numeric conversion and domain validation.
Accumulate only accepted records and report a stable final total.
zh: 读取整行，并维护从一开始的行号。
先检查结构，再做数值转换与领域验证。
只累加被接受记录，报告确定的最终总量。

title.en: Write and read a sensor record
title.zh: 写入再读取传感器记录

intro.en: Use byte-array streams so the program needs no file.
intro.zh: 使用字节数组流，不需要文件。

questions.output:
bytes=12
station=258
temperature=18.5
at end=true

en: Write fields in a named, fixed order.
Extract the byte array and verify its complete size.
Read the matching types and confirm no bytes remain.
zh: 按有名称、固定的顺序写字段。
取出字节数组并检查完整大小。
读取匹配类型并确认无剩余字节。

title.en: Inspect exact bytes and reject truncation
title.zh: 检查精确字节并拒绝截断

intro.en: A shortened copy deliberately lacks one required int byte.
intro.zh: 故意缩短副本，使 int 缺少一个必要字节。

questions.output:
hex=00 00 01 02
truncated int rejected

en: Encode a known integer and format each unsigned byte.
Create a deterministic three-byte truncated record.
Catch only EOFException from the incomplete primitive read.
zh: 编码已知整数，并格式化各无符号字节。
创建确定的三字节截断记录。
仅捕获不完整基本类型读取产生的 EOFException。

title.en: Represent events, uniqueness, and counts
title.zh: 表示事件、唯一值与计数

intro.en: Use one input sequence to expose three different contracts.
intro.zh: 用同一输入序列展示三种不同契约。

questions.output:
events=[Mia, Leo, Mia]
unique count=2
counts={Mia=2, Leo=1}
after replacement={Mia=3, Leo=1}, keys=2

en: Retain event order in a List and derive unique membership with a Set.
Accumulate one map count for every equal name.
Replace one mapping and inspect the unchanged key count.
zh: 用 List 保留事件顺序，用 Set 得到唯一成员。
为每个相等名称累计一个映射计数。
替换一个关联，再检查键数不变。

title.en: Contrast FIFO and LIFO with a deque
title.zh: 用双端队列比较先入先出与后入先出

intro.en: Both examples use endpoint operations rather than indexes.
intro.zh: 两个例子都使用端点操作，而非索引。

questions.output:

LIFO=elm, pine, oak
empty poll=null

en: Enqueue at one end and dequeue at the other.
Push and pop at the same end to form a stack.
Contrast throwing removal with sentinel-returning polling on empty input.
zh: 从一端入队、另一端出队。
在同一端压入与弹出，形成栈。
比较要求非空的删除与空时返回标记的轮询。

title.en: Use immutable seats as value keys
title.zh: 用不可变座位作为值键

intro.en: Equal separate objects become one logical set member.
intro.zh: 不同但相等的对象成为同一个逻辑集合成员。

questions.output:
identity=false
equal=true
equal hashes=true
logical seats=2

en: Define equality through Object so collections reach the correct override.
Compute hashes from exactly the equality fields.
Insert separate equal instances and inspect logical membership count.
zh: 以 Object 参数定义相等，使容器调用正确重写。
用恰好相等关系涉及的字段计算哈希。
插入不同但相等的实例，检查逻辑成员数量。

title.en: Keep unequal colliding keys distinct
title.zh: 区分哈希冲突的不等键

intro.en: A deliberately poor hash still needs correct equality.
intro.zh: 刻意使用差的哈希，仍保持正确相等关系。

questions.output:
keys=2
key 1=updated
key 2=south

title.en: A savings goal that guards its invariant

prompt.en:
Leon is saving for a laptop. Write a class SavingsGoal.

- The constructor SavingsGoal(String name, int target) rejects a null or empty name, and a target that is not positive. In both cases it throws IllegalArgumentException.
- A new goal has saved 0.
- int deposit(int amount) adds money. If amount is not positive, it throws IllegalArgumentException. The saved total must never go above the target. If the deposit would pass the target, add only the part that fits. Return the amount that was really added.
- int remaining() returns target minus saved.
- boolean isReached() is true when saved equals target.
- String getName() returns the name.

The rule that must always hold is: target > 0 and 0 <= saved <= target. Code outside the class must not be able to break it. All amounts are whole dollars.
prompt.zh:
Leon 想存钱买一台笔记本电脑。请写一个类 SavingsGoal。

- 构造器 SavingsGoal(String name, int target) 要拒绝 null 或空字符串的名称，也要拒绝不是正数的目标金额。这两种情况都抛出 IllegalArgumentException。
- 新建的目标，已存金额为 0。
- int deposit(int amount) 用来存钱。如果 amount 不是正数，抛出 IllegalArgumentException。已存金额永远不能超过目标：如果这笔存款会超过目标，就只加上放得下的那一部分。返回实际加上的金额。
- int remaining() 返回目标减去已存金额。
- boolean isReached() 在已存金额等于目标时返回 true。
- String getName() 返回名称。

必须始终成立的规则是：target > 0，并且 0 <= saved <= target。类外部的代码不能破坏这条规则。所有金额都是整数美元。

solution.en:
The invariant is target > 0 and 0 <= saved <= target. Three things protect it.

1. The fields are private, so no outside code can write to saved directly. The only way to change saved is deposit.
2. The constructor checks its arguments before it assigns anything. A bad call throws, so no half-built or invalid object ever escapes.
3. deposit adds Math.min(amount, target - saved). Since saved <= target before the call, target - saved is not negative, so after the call saved is still between 0 and target.

Returning the amount really added lets the caller see when the goal swallowed part of a deposit. Note that name and target are final: they are set once and never change, which keeps the invariant easy to argue.
solution.zh:
不变式是 target > 0 并且 0 <= saved <= target。有三处在保护它。

1. 字段都是 private，外部代码无法直接写 saved。改变 saved 的唯一途径是 deposit。
2. 构造器先检查参数，再赋值。参数不合法就抛出异常，所以不合法或只建好一半的对象永远不会流到外面。
3. deposit 只加 Math.min(amount, target - saved)。调用前 saved <= target，所以 target - saved 不是负数，调用后 saved 仍然在 0 到 target 之间。

返回实际加上的金额，调用者就能看出这笔存款有一部分被目标“吞掉”了。另外，name 和 target 是 final：它们只在构造时设置一次，之后不再改变，论证不变式就很简单。

text.en: The fields are private, and name and target are never changed after the constructor.
text.zh: 字段是 private 的，并且 name 和 target 在构造器之后不再被修改。

text.en: The constructor throws IllegalArgumentException for a null or empty name and for target <= 0, before it assigns the fields.
text.zh: 构造器对 null 或空名称、以及 target <= 0 抛出 IllegalArgumentException，并且是在给字段赋值之前检查。

text.en: deposit throws IllegalArgumentException when amount <= 0.
text.zh: deposit 在 amount <= 0 时抛出 IllegalArgumentException。

text.en: deposit adds at most target - saved, so saved never goes above target, and returns the amount really added.
text.zh: deposit 最多加上 target - saved，使 saved 不会超过 target，并返回实际加上的金额。

text.en: remaining(), isReached() and getName() are correct (isReached compares saved with target).
text.zh: remaining()、isReached() 和 getName() 都正确（isReached 用 saved 与 target 比较）。

mistakes.en: Writing name = name; in the constructor. The parameter hides the field, so the field stays null. Write this.name = name;.
mistakes.zh: 在构造器里写 name = name;。参数把字段遮住了，字段仍然是 null。应当写 this.name = name;。

mistakes.en: Assigning the fields first and checking afterwards. Even if the constructor then throws, the checks are easy to get wrong or forget.

title.en: Seats that a HashSet treats as equal
title.zh: 能让 HashSet 判为相等的座位类

prompt.en:
A cinema booking program keeps seats in a HashSet and uses them as HashMap keys. Write a class Seat.

- It has two int fields, row and number. A Seat never changes after it is built.
- The constructor is Seat(int row, int number).
- Override equals and hashCode so that two seats are equal exactly when both row and number are equal.
- A HashSet<Seat> must treat two separate objects created as Seat(3, 4) as the same seat.
- equals(null) and equals with an object of another class must return false. They must not throw an exception.

You do not need toString or getters.
prompt.zh:
一个电影院订座程序把座位放进 HashSet，并把座位当作 HashMap 的键。请写一个类 Seat。

- 它有两个 int 字段：row 和 number。Seat 对象在构造之后永远不变。
- 构造器是 Seat(int row, int number)。
- 重写 equals 和 hashCode，使得当且仅当 row 和 number 都相等时，两个座位才相等。
- HashSet<Seat> 必须把两个分别用 Seat(3, 4) 创建的对象当作同一个座位。
- equals(null)，以及与其他类的对象比较时，都必须返回 false，不能抛出异常。

不需要写 toString 或 getter。

solution.en:
equals must take an Object. If you write equals(Seat other), you only add an overload. A HashSet calls equals(Object), so it would never use your method. The annotation @Override makes the compiler catch this mistake.

The body has three steps: the quick check this == o, the type check o instanceof Seat (it is false for null, so no separate null test is needed), then a cast and a field-by-field comparison.

hashCode must use the same fields as equals. The contract says equal objects must have equal hash codes. HashSet first uses the hash code to pick a bucket and only then calls equals. If two equal seats had different hash codes, they would land in different buckets and the set would keep both. The formula 31 * row + number is a common simple choice. Different seats may share a hash code, which is allowed.
solution.zh:
equals 的参数必须是 Object。如果写成 equals(Seat other)，只是多了一个重载。HashSet 调用的是 equals(Object)，永远不会用到你写的这个方法。加上 @Override，编译器就能帮你发现这类错误。

方法体分三步：先用 this == o 快速判断；再用 o instanceof Seat 检查类型（对 null 结果是 false，所以不需要单独判断 null）；最后强制转换并逐个字段比较。

hashCode 必须使用与 equals 相同的字段。契约要求：相等的对象必须有相等的哈希码。HashSet 先用哈希码选桶，再调用 equals。如果两个相等的座位哈希码不同，它们会落进不同的桶，集合就会把两个都留下。31 * row + number 是常见的简单写法。不同的座位可以有相同的哈希码，这是允许的。

text.en: The fields are private final and the constructor stores both values.
text.zh: 字段是 private final，构造器保存了两个值。

text.en: equals has the signature public boolean equals(Object o) (not equals(Seat)).
text.zh: equals 的签名是 public boolean equals(Object o)，而不是 equals(Seat)。

text.en: equals returns false for null and for other types without throwing (for example with instanceof), then casts.
text.zh: equals 对 null 和其他类型返回 false 且不抛出异常（例如用 instanceof），之后再强制转换。

text.en: equals compares both row and number with ==.
text.zh: equals 用 == 同时比较 row 和 number。

text.en: hashCode is overridden and uses exactly the fields that equals uses, so equal seats have equal hash codes.
text.zh: 重写了 hashCode，并且使用的字段与 equals 完全相同，使相等的座位哈希码相等。

mistakes.en: Declaring equals(Seat other). It overloads instead of overriding, so HashSet and Object-typed calls ignore it.
mistakes.zh: 把方法写成 equals(Seat other)。这是重载而不是重写，HashSet 和以 Object 类型调用时都不会用到它。

mistakes.en: Overriding equals but not hashCode. Equal seats then usually get different hash codes, and the set keeps duplicates.
mistakes.zh: 只重写 equals 而不重写 hashCode。相等的座位通常哈希码不同，集合就会保留重复项。

mistakes.en: Casting before the type check. (Seat) o throws ClassCastException when o is a String.
mistakes.zh: 先强制转换、后检查类型。o 是 String 时，(Seat) o 会抛出 ClassCastException。

mistakes.en: Using row == other.row || number == other.number. The rule needs both fields to match, so use &&.
mistakes.zh: 写成 row == other.row || number == other.number。规则要求两个字段都相等，应当用 &&。

title.en: Count votes with a list and a map
title.zh: 用列表和映射统计投票

prompt.en:
Mia counts votes for a class prize. Write two static methods in class Main. The line import java.util.*; is already there.

1. static Map<String, Integer> tally(List<String> votes) returns a map from each name to the number of times it appears in votes. An empty list gives an empty map. The method must not change the list.
2. static String winner(Map<String, Integer> counts) returns the name with the highest count. If two or more names tie, return the one that comes first alphabetically (use compareTo). If the map is empty, return null.

Loop over the list with a for-each loop, and over the map with its entries. Do not use streams. Do not assume any iteration order for a HashMap.
prompt.zh:
Mia 为班级奖项统计投票。请在类 Main 中写两个静态方法。import java.util.*; 这一行已经写好。

1. static Map<String, Integer> tally(List<String> votes) 返回一个映射：每个名字对应它在 votes 中出现的次数。空列表得到空映射。这个方法不能修改列表。
2. static String winner(Map<String, Integer> counts) 返回票数最高的名字。如果有两个或更多名字并列，返回按字母顺序最靠前的那个（用 compareTo）。如果映射为空，返回 null。

用 for-each 循环遍历列表，用映射的条目遍历映射。不要使用流。不要假设 HashMap 的遍历顺序。

solution.en:
tally: for each vote, read the old count with get. If the name has no entry yet, get returns null, so the new count is 1; otherwise it is the old count plus one. Always write the answer back with put. The map is built fresh, so the input list is never touched.

winner: walk through entrySet() and keep the best name so far. A new entry replaces the best one in two cases: its count is higher, or its count is equal and its name is alphabetically smaller. Because the tie rule is part of the comparison, the result does not depend on the order in which the HashMap hands out its entries. That order is not specified, so code that depends on it is a bug waiting to happen.

The test best == null tells the loop that it is looking at the first entry. It also makes an empty map return null without a special case.
solution.zh:
tally：对每一票，用 get 读出旧计数。如果这个名字还没有条目，get 返回 null，新计数就是 1；否则是旧计数加一。每次都用 put 把结果写回去。映射是新建的，所以输入列表不会被改动。

winner：遍历 entrySet()，并记住到目前为止最好的名字。出现下面两种情况之一，新条目就替换当前最好的：它的票数更高，或者票数相同但名字按字母顺序更小。因为并列规则已经写进比较里，结果不依赖 HashMap 交出条目的顺序。这个顺序没有规定，依赖它的代码迟早会出错。

用 best == null 表示“还没有任何条目”，这样空映射不需要特殊处理，自然返回 null。

text.en: tally loops over the list and counts each name, adding to the old count.
text.zh: tally 遍历列表并统计每个名字，在旧计数上加一。

text.en: tally handles a name that is not in the map yet (null check or getOrDefault) and does not change the list.
text.zh: tally 处理了名字尚未出现在映射中的情况（判断 null 或用 getOrDefault），并且没有修改列表。

text.en: winner loops over the map's entries and tracks the best name and its count.
text.zh: winner 遍历映射的条目，并记录最好的名字及其票数。

text.en: Ties go to the alphabetically first name, using compareTo and not ==.
text.zh: 并列时选择字母顺序最靠前的名字，使用 compareTo 而不是 ==。

text.en: An empty map returns null.
text.zh: 空映射返回 null。

mistakes.en: Writing int old = counts.get(v) for a name that is not in the map. Unboxing null throws NullPointerException.
mistakes.zh: 名字不在映射中时写 int old = counts.get(v)。对 null 拆箱会抛出 NullPointerException。

mistakes.en: Calling counts.put(v, 1) every time. The count never goes above 1.
mistakes.zh: 每次都调用 counts.put(v, 1)，计数永远不会超过 1。

mistakes.en: Breaking ties by whichever entry the HashMap returns first. That order is unspecified.
mistakes.zh: 并列时取 HashMap 先返回的那个条目。这个顺序是没有规定的。

mistakes.en: Comparing names with < or ==. Strings need compareTo (order) and equals (equality).
mistakes.zh: 用 < 或 == 比较名字。字符串需要用 compareTo（顺序）和 equals（相等）。

title.en: Count the ways to climb stairs, with a memo
title.zh: 带记忆化地数爬楼梯的方法数

prompt.en:
Emma climbs a staircase with n steps. On each move she climbs 1, 2 or 3 steps. Different orders count as different ways, so 1 then 2 and 2 then 1 are two ways.

Write static long ways(int n) in class Main. It returns the number of different ways to climb exactly n steps.

Facts: ways(0) is 1 (do nothing), ways(1) is 1, ways(2) is 2, ways(3) is 4. Assume 0 <= n <= 60. The answer for n = 60 fits in a long.

Use recursion. A plain recursive solution makes far too many calls for n = 60, so store results you already computed in a HashMap<Integer, Long> and reuse them. A private helper method with an extra parameter is fine. Do not use streams.
prompt.zh:
Emma 要爬一段有 n 级台阶的楼梯。每一步她可以爬 1 级、2 级或 3 级。顺序不同算不同的方法，所以“先 1 级再 2 级”和“先 2 级再 1 级”是两种方法。

请在类 Main 中写 static long ways(int n)，返回恰好爬完 n 级台阶的不同方法数。

已知：ways(0) 是 1（什么都不做），ways(1) 是 1，ways(2) 是 2，ways(3) 是 4。假设 0 <= n <= 60。n = 60 时的答案可以放进 long。

请用递归。朴素的递归在 n = 60 时调用次数多到无法完成，所以要把已经算出的结果存进 HashMap<Integer, Long> 里重复使用。可以写一个多一个参数的 private 辅助方法。不要使用流。

solution.en:
Think about the last move. It was a 1-step, a 2-step or a 3-step move, so ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2) + ways(n-3). Each term counts the ways to reach the step before that last move.

Base cases: n == 0 gives 1, because there is exactly one way to be at the start: do nothing. A negative n gives 0, because you cannot climb a negative number of steps. With these two base cases, ways(1) = 1 + 0 + 0 = 1 and ways(2) = 1 + 1 + 0 = 2 come out right without being special cases.

Without a memo the call tree branches three ways at every level, so the work grows like 3 to the power n. Many subtrees repeat, for example ways(10) is computed again and again. With a memo each value of n is computed once, so there are only about n real computations. Check the memo before computing, and store the result before returning.

Use long all the way. ways(60) is a number with 16 digits, so an int would overflow.
solution.zh:
想最后一步：它要么走 1 级，要么走 2 级，要么走 3 级，所以 ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2) + ways(n-3)。每一项数的是走到“最后一步之前那一级”的方法数。

基本情况：n == 0 时返回 1，因为站在起点只有一种方式：什么都不做。n 为负数时返回 0，因为不可能爬负数级台阶。有了这两个基本情况，ways(1) = 1 + 0 + 0 = 1，ways(2) = 1 + 1 + 0 = 2 都能自然得到，不需要单独处理。

没有记忆化时，调用树每层分成三支，工作量大约按 3 的 n 次方增长，而且大量子树重复，例如 ways(10) 会被一遍遍重新计算。有了记忆化，每个 n 只算一次，真正的计算大约只有 n 次。要在计算之前先查记忆表，在返回之前先把结果存进去。

全程使用 long。ways(60) 是一个 16 位数，用 int 会溢出。

text.en: Base cases are correct: n == 0 returns 1 and n < 0 returns 0 (or an equivalent set that gives ways(1) = 1 and ways(2) = 2).
text.zh: 基本情况正确：n == 0 返回 1，n < 0 返回 0（或其他等价写法，使 ways(1) = 1、ways(2) = 2）。

text.en: The recursive step adds ways(n-1), ways(n-2) and ways(n-3).
text.zh: 递归步骤把 ways(n-1)、ways(n-2) 和 ways(n-3) 相加。

text.en: Checks the memo before computing, and returns the stored value when it is there.
text.zh: 计算之前先查记忆表，如果已有就直接返回存储的值。

text.en: Stores the new result in the memo before returning.
text.zh: 返回之前把新结果存入记忆表。

text.en: Uses long for the results and the memo values, so n = 60 does not overflow.
text.zh: 结果和记忆表的值都使用 long，使 n = 60 时不溢出。

mistakes.en: Forgetting the base case for n == 0, so the recursion never stops adding zeros or runs off to negative n.
mistakes.zh: 忘记 n == 0 的基本情况，递归永远停不下来，或者一路走到负数。

mistakes.en: Writing int known = memo.get(n). When n is not in the map, get returns null and unboxing it throws NullPointerException.
mistakes.zh: 写成 int known = memo.get(n)。n 不在映射里时 get 返回 null，拆箱会抛出 NullPointerException。

mistakes.en: Creating a new empty memo inside every recursive call. Nothing is ever reused, so it is as slow as no memo.
mistakes.zh: 在每次递归调用里都新建一个空的记忆表。结果永远用不上，和没有记忆化一样慢。

mistakes.en: Using int for the total. The sum overflows silently for larger n and gives wrong numbers.
mistakes.zh: 总和使用 int。n 较大时会悄悄溢出，得到错误的数。

title.en: Version numbers that sort correctly
title.zh: 能正确排序的版本号类

prompt.en:
Jack's app sorts version numbers such as 1.9 and 1.10. Write a class Version that implements Comparable<Version>.

- Two int fields, major and minor. A Version never changes after it is built.
- The constructor is Version(int major, int minor).
- compareTo orders by major first, then by minor. The order is numeric, so 1.9 comes before 1.10.
- toString returns major, a dot, then minor, for example "1.10".
- boolean isNewerThan(Version other) is true when this version comes after other. Use compareTo to write it.

Collections.sort and Collections.max must work on a list of Version objects.
prompt.zh:
Jack 的应用要对 1.9、1.10 这样的版本号排序。请写一个实现 Comparable<Version> 的类 Version。

- 两个 int 字段：major 和 minor。Version 对象在构造之后永远不变。
- 构造器是 Version(int major, int minor)。
- compareTo 先按 major 排序，再按 minor 排序。顺序是按数值比较的，所以 1.9 排在 1.10 前面。
- toString 返回 major、一个点、再加 minor，例如 "1.10"。
- boolean isNewerThan(Version other) 在本版本排在 other 之后时返回 true。请用 compareTo 来写。

Collections.sort 和 Collections.max 必须能处理 Version 对象的列表。

solution.en:
Implementing an interface is a promise: the class must supply every abstract method, with the same signature and public access. For Comparable<Version> the method is public int compareTo(Version other). Methods that implement an interface method must be public, because interface methods are public. Leaving out public is a compile error.

The contract of compareTo is: a negative number when this comes first, zero when they are equal in order, a positive number when this comes later. Compare the most important field first and only look at the next field on a tie.

The numbers must be compared as numbers. If you compare toString() texts, "1.10" sorts before "1.9", because the character '1' comes before '9'. That is the whole point of this exercise.

Integer.compare avoids the overflow that a subtraction such as a - b can cause for large values. isNewerThan reuses compareTo, so the ordering rule lives in one place.
solution.zh:
实现接口就是一个承诺：类必须提供每个抽象方法，签名相同，并且是 public。对 Comparable<Version> 来说，这个方法是 public int compareTo(Version other)。实现接口方法的方法必须是 public，因为接口方法本来就是 public。漏写 public 会产生编译错误。

compareTo 的契约是：本对象应排在前面时返回负数，顺序相同返回 0，应排在后面时返回正数。先比较最重要的字段，只有它们相同才去看下一个字段。

数字必须按数值比较。如果比较 toString() 得到的文本，"1.10" 会排在 "1.9" 前面，因为字符 '1' 排在 '9' 前面。这正是本题要考的地方。

Integer.compare 可以避免 a - b 这种减法在数值很大时造成的溢出。isNewerThan 复用 compareTo，这样排序规则只写在一个地方。

text.en: The class header says implements Comparable<Version>; the fields are private final and set by the constructor.
text.zh: 类头写了 implements Comparable<Version>；字段是 private final，并由构造器设置。

text.en: compareTo is declared public int compareTo(Version other).
text.zh: compareTo 声明为 public int compareTo(Version other)。

text.en: compareTo compares major first, and compares minor only when major is equal, using numbers and not text.
text.zh: compareTo 先比较 major，只有 major 相等才比较 minor，并且按数值而不是文本比较。

text.en: toString returns the text major + "." + minor and is declared public.
text.zh: toString 返回 major + "." + minor 的文本，并且声明为 public。

text.en: isNewerThan calls compareTo and tests for a result greater than 0 (not equal to 1).
text.zh: isNewerThan 调用 compareTo，并判断结果大于 0（而不是等于 1）。

mistakes.en: Leaving out public on compareTo or toString. An implementing method cannot have weaker access than the interface method.
mistakes.zh: compareTo 或 toString 漏写 public。实现接口方法时，访问权限不能比接口里的方法更弱。

mistakes.en: Comparing toString() texts. "1.10" then sorts before "1.9".
mistakes.zh: 比较 toString() 的文本。这样 "1.10" 会排在 "1.9" 前面。

mistakes.en: Checking compareTo(other) == 1. The contract only promises a positive number, not exactly 1.
mistakes.zh: 判断 compareTo(other) == 1。契约只保证返回正数，并不保证恰好是 1。

mistakes.en: Returning a boolean from compareTo. It must return an int.
mistakes.zh: 让 compareTo 返回 boolean。它必须返回 int。

title.en: An abstract class and two subclasses
title.zh: 一个抽象类和两个子类

prompt.en:
A small company pays two kinds of staff. Write three classes.

1. abstract class Staff. It has a name, set by the constructor Staff(String name). It has an abstract method int monthlyPay(). It has a concrete method String payslip() that returns the name, then the text " earns ", then the monthly pay. For example "Mia earns 5000".
2. class Salaried extends Staff. Constructor Salaried(String name, int yearly). The monthly pay is yearly / 12 (integer division).
3. class Hourly extends Staff. Constructor Hourly(String name, int rate, int hours). The first 160 hours are paid at rate each. Every hour above 160 is paid at one and a half times the rate. Compute the overtime pay as (overtimeHours * rate * 3) / 2 in integer arithmetic.

payslip must work for any kind of Staff without checking the type. All pay values are whole dollars.
prompt.zh:
一家小公司有两类员工要发工资。请写三个类。

1. abstract class Staff。它有一个名字，由构造器 Staff(String name) 设置。它有一个抽象方法 int monthlyPay()，还有一个具体方法 String payslip()，返回名字、文本 " earns "，再加上月薪。例如 "Mia earns 5000"。
2. class Salaried extends Staff。构造器是 Salaried(String name, int yearly)。月薪是 yearly / 12（整数除法）。
3. class Hourly extends Staff。构造器是 Hourly(String name, int rate, int hours)。前 160 小时每小时付 rate。超过 160 的每个小时按 rate 的 1.5 倍支付。加班工资用整数运算计算：(overtimeHours * rate * 3) / 2。

payslip 必须对任何一种 Staff 都能工作，不能检查具体类型。所有工资都是整数美元。

solution.en:
An abstract class is the right tool when the subclasses share state and some code (the name and payslip) but each must supply one step differently (monthlyPay). Staff cannot be instantiated: new Staff("x") does not compile. Each concrete subclass must implement monthlyPay, or it would have to be abstract too.

The constructor of Staff stores the name. A subclass constructor must call it with super(name) as its first statement, because Staff has no constructor without arguments.

payslip is written once in Staff and calls monthlyPay(). At run time the call goes to the version of the object that was really created. This is dynamic dispatch: a Staff variable that holds a Salaried object runs Salaried.monthlyPay. That is why payslip needs no instanceof.

For Hourly, split the hours: min(hours, 160) at the normal rate, and max(0, hours - 160) at one and a half times. With rate 20 and 170 hours: 160 * 20 = 3200, and 10 * 20 * 3 / 2 = 300, so 3500.
solution.zh:
当子类共享状态和一部分代码（名字和 payslip），但每个子类必须用自己的方式完成其中一步（monthlyPay）时，抽象类是合适的工具。Staff 不能被实例化：new Staff("x") 无法编译。每个具体子类都必须实现 monthlyPay，否则它自己也必须是 abstract。

Staff 的构造器保存名字。子类构造器必须用 super(name) 作为第一条语句来调用它，因为 Staff 没有无参构造器。

payslip 只在 Staff 里写一次，并调用 monthlyPay()。运行时，这个调用会进入真正被创建的那个对象的版本。这就是动态分派：持有 Salaried 对象的 Staff 变量，运行的是 Salaried.monthlyPay。所以 payslip 不需要 instanceof。

对 Hourly，把工时拆开：min(hours, 160) 按普通费率，max(0, hours - 160) 按 1.5 倍。费率 20、工作 170 小时：160 * 20 = 3200，加上 10 * 20 * 3 / 2 = 300，共 3500。

text.en: Staff is declared abstract, has the abstract method int monthlyPay(), and stores the name through its constructor.
text.zh: Staff 声明为 abstract，有抽象方法 int monthlyPay()，并通过构造器保存名字。

text.en: payslip is a concrete method in Staff that calls monthlyPay() and builds the text name + " earns " + pay.
text.zh: payslip 是 Staff 里的具体方法，调用 monthlyPay() 并拼出 name + " earns " + 月薪 的文本。

title.en: Bounded generic methods
title.zh: 带类型界限的泛型方法

prompt.en:
Write two static generic methods in class Main. The line import java.util.*; is already there. Both must work for any element type that can compare itself with its own kind, such as Integer and String. Do not write a separate method for each type.

1. static <T ...> T maxOf(List<T> items) returns the largest element. If the list is empty, throw IllegalArgumentException.
2. static <T ...> int countAbove(List<T> items, T limit) returns how many elements are strictly greater than limit.

Fill in the type parameter declaration yourself. Use compareTo to compare elements. Do not use streams and do not cast to Comparable.
prompt.zh:
请在类 Main 中写两个静态泛型方法。import java.util.*; 这一行已经写好。两个方法都要适用于任何“能与同类对象比较大小”的元素类型，例如 Integer 和 String。不要为每种类型单独写一个方法。

1. static <T ...> T maxOf(List<T> items) 返回最大的元素。如果列表为空，抛出 IllegalArgumentException。
2. static <T ...> int countAbove(List<T> items, T limit) 返回严格大于 limit 的元素个数。

类型参数的声明请自己补全。用 compareTo 比较元素。不要使用流，也不要强制转换成 Comparable。

solution.en:
The type parameter list <T extends Comparable<T>> goes before the return type. It says: T may be any type, provided T can be compared with other T objects. This bound is what allows item.compareTo(best) to compile. With a plain <T>, the compiler only knows that items are Objects, and Object has no compareTo.

The relational operators > and < work only for numbers, so they cannot be used on T. Use compareTo and test the sign of the result: > 0 means "greater".

maxOf starts from the first element and replaces it whenever a bigger one appears, using a strict > so that equal elements do not matter. Check for an empty list first, because items.get(0) would fail.

Because T is inferred from the arguments, a call like maxOf(wordList) returns a String with no cast. That is the type safety that generics add. The type parameter is one type: in countAbove the limit has the same type T as the elements.
solution.zh:
类型参数列表 <T extends Comparable<T>> 写在返回类型之前。它的意思是：T 可以是任何类型，只要 T 能与其他 T 对象比较大小。正是这个界限让 item.compareTo(best) 能够通过编译。如果只写 <T>，编译器只知道元素是 Object，而 Object 没有 compareTo。

关系运算符 > 和 < 只能用于数字，不能用在 T 上。要使用 compareTo，并判断结果的符号：> 0 表示“更大”。

maxOf 从第一个元素开始，每当出现更大的元素就替换它，这里用严格的 >，所以相等的元素没有影响。要先检查空列表，否则 items.get(0) 会失败。

T 是从实参推断出来的，所以像 maxOf(wordList) 这样的调用直接返回 String，不需要强制转换。这就是泛型带来的类型安全。类型参数代表同一个类型：在 countAbove 里，limit 与元素是同一个类型 T。

text.en: Both methods declare <T extends Comparable<T>> before the return type (a bound that makes compareTo available).
text.zh: 两个方法都在返回类型之前声明了 <T extends Comparable<T>>（有了这个界限，compareTo 才可用）。

text.en: maxOf throws IllegalArgumentException for an empty list before reading any element.
text.zh: maxOf 在读取任何元素之前，对空列表抛出 IllegalArgumentException。

text.en: maxOf keeps a best-so-far value and replaces it when compareTo shows a larger element.
text.zh: maxOf 记录目前最大的值，当 compareTo 显示出现更大的元素时替换它。

text.en: countAbove counts elements with compareTo(limit) > 0 (strictly greater, not >=).
text.zh: countAbove 用 compareTo(limit) > 0 统计元素个数（严格大于，不是 >=）。

text.en: Compares with compareTo and not with > or ==.
text.zh: 用 compareTo 比较，而不是用 > 或 ==。

mistakes.en: Declaring <T> with no bound, then calling compareTo. The compiler says the method is not found, because T is only known as Object.
mistakes.zh: 只写 <T> 而不加界限，却调用 compareTo。编译器会说找不到该方法，因为它只知道 T 是 Object。

mistakes.en: Writing the type parameter after the return type, as in T <T> maxOf. It must come before the return type.
mistakes.zh: 把类型参数写在返回类型之后，例如 T <T> maxOf。它必须写在返回类型之前。

mistakes.en: Using item > best. Relational operators do not work on a type parameter.
mistakes.zh: 写成 item > best。关系运算符不能用在类型参数上。

mistakes.en: Using >= in countAbove, which also counts elements equal to the limit.
mistakes.zh: 在 countAbove 里用 >=，这样也会把等于 limit 的元素算进去。

mistakes.en: Returning null for an empty list instead of throwing, when the task says to throw.
mistakes.zh: 题目要求抛出异常，却对空列表返回 null。

title.en: A custom checked exception, thrown and caught
title.zh: 自定义受检查异常：抛出与捕获

prompt.en:
Noah runs a small shop. The class Shelf is already written (see the code). Write the rest.

1. class OutOfStockException. It must be a checked exception. It has a constructor OutOfStockException(String message, int missing) and a method int getMissing().
2. In Shelf, add void take(String item, int qty). It removes qty items from the shelf. If the shelf holds fewer than qty of that item (including an item that is not on the shelf), it throws OutOfStockException. The value of missing is how many are lacking. A failed take must leave the shelf unchanged. The method must declare the exception.
3. In class Main, add static String order(Shelf shelf, String item, int qty). It calls take. If that works it returns "OK". If the shelf is short it catches the exception and returns "SHORT " followed by the missing number, for example "SHORT 2".
prompt.zh:
Noah 开了一家小店。类 Shelf 已经写好（见代码）。请写出其余部分。

1. 类 OutOfStockException。它必须是受检查异常。它有构造器 OutOfStockException(String message, int missing) 和方法 int getMissing()。
2. 在 Shelf 里添加 void take(String item, int qty)。它从货架上取走 qty 件商品。如果货架上该商品的数量少于 qty（包括货架上根本没有这种商品），就抛出 OutOfStockException。missing 的值是缺少的数量。失败的 take 不能改变货架。这个方法必须声明会抛出该异常。
3. 在类 Main 里添加 static String order(Shelf shelf, String item, int qty)。它调用 take。如果成功，返回 "OK"。如果货架缺货，就捕获异常，并返回 "SHORT " 加上缺少的数量，例如 "SHORT 2"。

solution.en:
A checked exception extends Exception (not RuntimeException). The compiler then forces every caller to either catch it or declare it. Here the class carries one extra fact, missing, so the caller can react to the size of the shortage, not only to the fact that something went wrong.

take has two jobs: check, then change. Do the check first. If it fails, throw before touching the map. That gives the guarantee that a failed call leaves the shelf unchanged. If you removed the items first and checked afterwards, a failed order would leave a wrong count behind.

The clause throws OutOfStockException in the header of take is required. Without it, the throw statement does not compile. It also forces order to deal with the exception: order catches it and turns it into a plain text result.

Keep the try block small. Only the call that can throw is inside it, and the return "OK" follows the call, so it only runs when take did not throw.
solution.zh:
受检查异常继承 Exception（而不是 RuntimeException）。这样编译器会强制每个调用者要么捕获它，要么声明它。这里的异常类多带了一个信息 missing，调用者就可以根据缺货的数量作出反应，而不只是知道出了问题。

take 有两件事：先检查，再修改。要先检查。如果检查失败，就在碰映射之前抛出异常。这就保证了失败的调用不会改变货架。如果先扣除、后检查，失败的订单会留下错误的数量。

take 方法头里的 throws OutOfStockException 是必须的。没有它，throw 语句无法通过编译。它也迫使 order 处理这个异常：order 捕获异常，并把它变成普通的文本结果。

try 块要小。只有可能抛出异常的那个调用在里面，return "OK" 紧跟在调用之后，所以只有 take 没有抛出异常时才会执行。

text.en: OutOfStockException extends Exception (checked), stores missing, passes the message to super, and has getMissing().
text.zh: OutOfStockException 继承 Exception（受检查异常），保存 missing，把 message 传给 super，并有 getMissing()。

text.en: take throws OutOfStockException with missing = qty - have when the stock is too low, and its header declares throws OutOfStockException.
text.zh: 库存不足时，take 抛出 OutOfStockException，且 missing = qty - have；方法头声明了 throws OutOfStockException。

text.en: take checks first, so a failed call changes nothing; on success it reduces the stock.
text.zh: take 先检查，所以失败的调用不会改变任何东西；成功时才减少库存。

text.en: order calls take inside try and returns "OK" when no exception is thrown.
text.zh: order 在 try 里调用 take，没有抛出异常时返回 "OK"。

text.en: order catches OutOfStockException and returns "SHORT " + e.getMissing().
text.zh: order 捕获 OutOfStockException，并返回 "SHORT " + e.getMissing()。

mistakes.en: Extending RuntimeException by habit. The task says checked, so extend Exception.
mistakes.zh: 习惯性地继承 RuntimeException。题目要求受检查异常，应当继承 Exception。

mistakes.en: Forgetting throws in the header of take. The compiler reports an unreported exception.
mistakes.zh: take 的方法头忘记写 throws。编译器会报告未处理的异常。

mistakes.en: Reducing the stock before the check. A failed order then still changes the count (and may make it negative).
mistakes.zh: 在检查之前先减少库存。失败的订单仍会改变数量（甚至变成负数）。

mistakes.en: Catching Exception in order. It hides unrelated problems; catch the specific type.
mistakes.zh: 在 order 里捕获 Exception。这样会掩盖不相关的问题；应当捕获具体的类型。

mistakes.en: Writing throw OutOfStockException(...) without new.
mistakes.zh: 写成 throw OutOfStockException(...)，漏了 new。

title.en: A small iterator that counts down
title.zh: 一个倒数的小迭代器

prompt.en:
Write a class Countdown that implements Iterable<Integer>, so that a for-each loop can walk through it.

- The constructor is Countdown(int start).
- A traversal gives start, start - 1, and so on, down to 1. If start is less than 1, the traversal gives nothing.
- Each call to iterator() starts a new traversal. Two iterators made from the same Countdown must not disturb each other.
- next() on an iterator that has run out throws NoSuchElementException.
- On paper you may skip remove(). To run the tests in the browser, add public void remove() that throws UnsupportedOperationException (the browser's Java library has no default for it).

The line import java.util.*; is already there.
prompt.zh:
请写一个实现 Iterable<Integer> 的类 Countdown，使 for-each 循环可以遍历它。

- 构造器是 Countdown(int start)。
- 一次遍历依次给出 start、start - 1，一直到 1。如果 start 小于 1，遍历什么也不给出。
- 每次调用 iterator() 都开始一次新的遍历。同一个 Countdown 产生的两个迭代器不能互相干扰。
- 对已经走完的迭代器调用 next()，抛出 NoSuchElementException。
- 在纸上可以不写 remove()。如果要在浏览器里运行测试，请再加上 public void remove()，让它抛出 UnsupportedOperationException（浏览器里的 Java 库没有它的默认实现）。

import java.util.*; 这一行已经写好。

solution.en:
A for-each loop over an Iterable calls iterator() once, then hasNext() and next() until hasNext() is false. So the class that is walked (Countdown) and the object that remembers the position (the iterator) have different jobs.

The position must live in the iterator, not in Countdown. Here it is the field current of the anonymous Iterator object, and it starts at start every time iterator() is called. Two calls give two objects with two separate current fields, so they do not disturb each other.

If Countdown kept the position in one of its own fields and returned this as the iterator, the second iterator would see the position of the first, and a traversal could not be repeated.

hasNext only looks; next looks and moves. Calling hasNext twice must not skip an element. Throwing NoSuchElementException when there is nothing left is the standard contract of Iterator.next. Both methods are public, because they implement interface methods.
solution.zh:
对 Iterable 的 for-each 循环先调用一次 iterator()，然后不断调用 hasNext() 和 next()，直到 hasNext() 为 false。所以被遍历的类（Countdown）和记住位置的对象（迭代器）各有分工。

位置必须保存在迭代器里，而不是 Countdown 里。这里它是匿名 Iterator 对象的字段 current，每次调用 iterator() 时都从 start 开始。两次调用得到两个对象、两个互相独立的 current 字段，所以它们不会互相干扰。

如果 Countdown 把位置存在自己的字段里，并把 this 当作迭代器返回，那么第二个迭代器会看到第一个迭代器的位置，遍历也就不能重复进行。

hasNext 只查看；next 既查看又移动。连续调用两次 hasNext 不能跳过元素。没有元素时抛出 NoSuchElementException，是 Iterator.next 的标准契约。两个方法都是 public，因为它们实现的是接口方法。

text.en: The class header says implements Iterable<Integer> and iterator() is public and returns Iterator<Integer>.
text.zh: 类头写了 implements Iterable<Integer>，iterator() 是 public 的，并返回 Iterator<Integer>。

text.en: The position is stored in the iterator object (an inner or anonymous class field), initialised to start for each new iterator.
text.zh: 位置保存在迭代器对象里（内部类或匿名类的字段），每个新迭代器都从 start 开始。

text.en: hasNext returns true exactly while the current value is at least 1, without changing the position.
text.zh: hasNext 恰好在当前值至少为 1 时返回 true，并且不改变位置。

text.en: next returns the current value and then moves to the next smaller one.
text.zh: next 返回当前值，然后移动到下一个更小的值。

text.en: next throws NoSuchElementException when the traversal is finished, and start < 1 gives an empty traversal.
text.zh: 遍历结束后 next 抛出 NoSuchElementException，start < 1 时遍历为空。

mistakes.en: Keeping the current position as a field of Countdown and returning this from iterator(). Two iterators share it.
mistakes.zh: 把当前位置存成 Countdown 的字段，并让 iterator() 返回 this。两个迭代器会共用它。

mistakes.en: Changing the position in hasNext(). Calling hasNext twice then skips a value.
mistakes.zh: 在 hasNext() 里改变位置。连续调用两次 hasNext 就会跳过一个值。

mistakes.en: Declaring iterator(), hasNext() or next() without public.
mistakes.zh: 声明 iterator()、hasNext() 或 next() 时漏写 public。

mistakes.en: Returning null at the end instead of throwing NoSuchElementException.
mistakes.zh: 遍历结束时返回 null，而不是抛出 NoSuchElementException。

title.en: An enum for the stages of a parcel
title.zh: 表示包裹阶段的枚举

prompt.en:
A parcel moves through four stages in this order: ORDERED, PACKED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED. Write an enum Stage and one static method.

- Each stage has a number of days left until delivery: ORDERED 3, PACKED 2, SHIPPED 1, DELIVERED 0. Store it in a field set by the enum's constructor, and return it from int daysLeft().
- Stage next() returns the following stage. DELIVERED has no following stage, so it returns DELIVERED. Write it with a switch.
- boolean isFinal() is true only for DELIVERED.
- In class Main: static Stage advance(Stage start, int steps) moves forward by steps stages, and stops at DELIVERED. steps is never negative.
prompt.zh:
一个包裹按这个顺序经过四个阶段：ORDERED、PACKED、SHIPPED、DELIVERED。请写一个枚举 Stage 和一个静态方法。

- 每个阶段都有一个“距离送达还剩几天”的数：ORDERED 为 3，PACKED 为 2，SHIPPED 为 1，DELIVERED 为 0。把它保存在由枚举构造器设置的字段里，并通过 int daysLeft() 返回。
- Stage next() 返回下一个阶段。DELIVERED 没有下一个阶段，所以返回 DELIVERED。请用 switch 来写。
- boolean isFinal() 只对 DELIVERED 返回 true。
- 在类 Main 里：static Stage advance(Stage start, int steps) 向前移动 steps 个阶段，并停在 DELIVERED。steps 不会是负数。

solution.en:
An enum is a class with a fixed list of instances. The constants come first, followed by a semicolon when the enum also has fields and methods. Each constant calls the enum's constructor, here with its daysLeft number. The constructor is implicitly private, so no other stage can ever be created.

Inside a switch on an enum, the case labels are the bare constant names (case ORDERED, not case Stage.ORDERED). The default branch covers SHIPPED and DELIVERED, which both lead to DELIVERED. The explicit rule that DELIVERED returns DELIVERED is what makes the state machine safe at its end.

A tempting shortcut is values()[ordinal() + 1]. It depends on the order of the declaration and fails with ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException at DELIVERED. The switch is explicit about every transition.

advance applies next() repeatedly. Because DELIVERED maps to itself, extra steps are harmless, so no special stop test is needed. Compare enum constants with == ; there is only ever one instance of each.
solution.zh:
枚举是一个“实例清单固定”的类。常量写在最前面；如果枚举还有字段和方法，常量列表后要加分号。每个常量都会调用枚举的构造器，这里传入它的 daysLeft 数值。枚举的构造器隐含是 private 的，所以不可能再创建出别的阶段。

在对枚举的 switch 里，case 标签直接写常量名（写 case ORDERED，而不是 case Stage.ORDERED）。default 分支覆盖 SHIPPED 和 DELIVERED，它们都通向 DELIVERED。“DELIVERED 返回 DELIVERED”这条明确的规则，让状态机在终点是安全的。

一个诱人的捷径是 values()[ordinal() + 1]。它依赖声明的顺序，而且在 DELIVERED 处会抛出 ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException。switch 把每一次转换都写得明明白白。

advance 重复调用 next()。因为 DELIVERED 映射到它自己，多出来的步数没有害处，所以不需要专门的停止判断。比较枚举常量用 ==；每个常量只有一个实例。

text.en: Declares enum Stage with the four constants in the right order.
text.zh: 声明了 enum Stage，四个常量的顺序正确。

text.en: Constants pass their days to a constructor, which stores them in a private final field; daysLeft() returns it.
text.zh: 常量把天数传给构造器，构造器把它存入 private final 字段；daysLeft() 返回该字段。

text.en: next() uses a switch on this (or on the stage) and DELIVERED returns DELIVERED.
text.zh: next() 对 this 使用 switch，并且 DELIVERED 返回 DELIVERED。

text.en: isFinal() is true only for DELIVERED (compares with == or uses a switch).
text.zh: isFinal() 只对 DELIVERED 为 true（用 == 比较或用 switch）。

text.en: advance loops steps times calling next(), and returns the final stage; 0 steps returns start.
text.zh: advance 循环 steps 次调用 next()，并返回最终阶段；0 步时返回 start。

mistakes.en: Writing case Stage.ORDERED: in a switch. Case labels for an enum use the bare name.
mistakes.zh: 在 switch 里写 case Stage.ORDERED:。枚举的 case 标签只用常量名。

mistakes.en: Forgetting the semicolon after the last constant when the enum has a field or method.
mistakes.zh: 枚举有字段或方法时，最后一个常量后面忘记写分号。

mistakes.en: Using values()[ordinal() + 1]. It crashes at DELIVERED and breaks if someone reorders the constants.
mistakes.zh: 使用 values()[ordinal() + 1]。它在 DELIVERED 处会崩溃，而且有人调整常量顺序就会出错。

mistakes.en: Writing new Stage(3) or calling the constructor yourself. Enum constants are created by the enum itself.
mistakes.zh: 写 new Stage(3) 或自己去调用构造器。枚举常量由枚举自己创建。
